title: Equivalence tolerance table
description: Cross-stack equivalence tolerance table (spec § 2.6). Per-category defaults + optional per-sim overrides. Phase-3 additive extension: render-similarity thresholds per (category, sim) under top-level `render_similarity` (D-SCHEMA Stage-1a lean; schema only, no Phase-3 rows — tasks 6 and 8 add rows).

render_similarity.description: Phase-3 additive extension (D-SCHEMA). Render-similarity thresholds per (category, sim). PSNR/SSIM are floor-thresholds (`*_min`; larger = more similar); LPIPS is a ceiling-threshold (`lpips_max`; smaller = more similar). Phase-3 §2.12 quality floors: PSNR ≥ 28 dB, SSIM ≥ 0.85, LPIPS ≤ 0.15. Tasks 6 and 8 add rows; this sub-phase (render-similarity) ships the schema only.

additionalProperties.description: Per-category render-similarity table (key = sim category, e.g. `continuous-ca` or `neural-rendered`).

psnr_min.description: PSNR floor (dB); sim PASSES if measured PSNR >= psnr_min. Phase-3 §2.12 floor = 28 dB.

ssim_min.description: SSIM floor; sim PASSES if measured SSIM >= ssim_min. Phase-3 §2.12 floor = 0.85.

lpips_max.description: LPIPS ceiling; sim PASSES if measured LPIPS <= lpips_max. Phase-3 §2.12 ceiling = 0.15.
